response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, including C++ in a past role at National Instruments, but lacks recent hands-on experience with C++ and modern industrial automation technologies. While they demonstrate strong problem-solving and architectural skills, their profile skews toward web/mobile development and scripting rather than the core C++ and cloud/IoT requirements needed for this role.
strengths: Proven experience with C++ from past roles (National Instruments) and strong multi-language versatility
Demonstrated ability to design scalable systems (e.g., data integration at dunnhumby handling millions of requests/sec)
Active open-source contributions and community engagement (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts)
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience (last significant work in 2015) and no direct exposure to industrial automation protocols (e.g., Modbus, OPC UA)
No clear evidence of adhering to secure development lifecycle (SDL) or IEC 62443 standards
Profile heavily focused on web/mobile development rather than on-premises/cloud industrial solutions
